import sys,json,os,time,traceback
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
r=Robot()
cams=['head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1']
o=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True)
idx=0
def save(o,label):
 global idx
 idx+=1
 path=f'/app/output/{idx:03d}_{label}'
 o.save(path)
 for c in ['head_camera','world_camera1','observer_camera']:
  Image.fromarray(o.last[c]).resize((960,720)).save('/app/output/'+c+'_latest.png')
 json.dump(o.meta,open('/app/output/latest.json','w'))
 print(path, {k:o.meta.get(k) for k in ['done','reason','time_left_s','plan']},flush=True)
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);print('EE',p[14:28], 'TCP',p[56:70],'grip',p[[36,43]],flush=True)
 return o
def obs(label='obs'):
 global o
 o=save(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True),label)
 return o
def move(arm,xyz,q,grip,label):
 global o
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);a=np.r_[p[14:21],p[28],p[21:28],p[29]]
 qi=np.array(q);rot=R.from_quat(qi[[1,2,3,0]])
 ee=np.array(xyz)-.12*rot.as_matrix()[:,0]
 off=0 if arm=='l' else 8
 a[off:off+8]=np.r_[ee,qi,grip]
 o=save(r.submit('ee_pose',a,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='mp4',note=label),label)
 return o
def grip(arm,value,label):
 global o
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);a=p[:14].copy();a[6 if arm=='l' else 13]=value
 o=save(r.submit('joint_position',np.tile(a,(20,1)),dt=.05,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,note=label),label)
 return o
save(o,'ready')
while True:
 try:
  line=sys.stdin.readline()
  if not line:break
  exec(line,globals())
 except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
